purpose: Find weak network-reachability positions without inventing hospitals, shelters, opportunities or population.

execution_tiers.name: Equal-opportunity harmonic accessibility
execution_tiers.method: directed shortest-path reachability and normalised harmonic closeness

primary_sources.citation: Hansen (1959), How accessibility shapes land use

known_limitations: Base-tier opportunities are equal network nodes.
Node map positions are incident-link coordinate proxies.
